title: Capacity heatmap + rollout calendar Q1 2027
content:
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
This sheet is a compact, operational view intended for infrastructure on-call, capacity planners, and finance to align on a calendarized GPU rollout across NA / EU / APAC for Q1 2027. It emphasizes: a) where risk is concentrated month-to-month, b) a minimal reservation strategy (buffer tiers), and c) a compact heatmap for quick handoff to SRE/Cloud procurement.

Key goals:
- Meet 95th-percentile latency SLO for hosted API while keeping committed spend lower than prior reserve runs.
- Maintain a 12-18% operational buffer (hot spare) per-region in Jan, ramp to 8-12% by Mar via elastic burst pools.
- Stagger major capacity increases to avoid cloud quota spikes and supporting-oncall churn.

ASSUMPTIONS:
- Workload growth: +28% token throughput expected Jan->Mar 2027 (derived from product telemetry, weekly rolling average).
- Preferred GPU families: H100 for latency-sensitive endpoints; A100 (80GB) for high-throughput batching. Small inference types use T4/RTX where available for non-critical customers.
- Cross-region fallback policy enabled: NA->EU fallback only for non-data-residency traffic; EU->NA fallback disabled for regulated customers.
- Lead time: 14 days for reserved capacity activation (cloud + procurement), 3-5 days for spot/burst capacity.
- Target avg utilization bands: Green=55-70%, Amber=70-85%, Red=>85%.

ROLLUP TABLE: Q1 2027 monthly slices (count = dedicated GPUs equivalent, normalized to H100-eq units)

Columns: Region | Month | Platform | Target H100-eq capacity | Expected avg util (%) | Buffer (%) | Notes
NA | Jan 2027 | Dedicated (GCP/US-west) | 1,200 | 64 | 16 | Initial ramp for product holiday tail; gating: quota requests open 2026-12-15
NA | Feb 2027 | Dedicated + Burst | 1,390 | 71 | 14 | Bring online extra A100 pools for batch-heavy routes; enable KV-cache sticky pools
NA | Mar 2027 | Dedicated + Reserved burst | 1,560 | 77 | 10 | Peak growth; prepare canary on H100-pool-4

EU | Jan 2027 | Dedicated (Azure/WestEU) | 720 | 59 | 18 | Slow ramp to respect on-prem vendor delivery windows
EU | Feb 2027 | Dedicated | 820 | 68 | 15 | Enable fallback lanes for non-EU data; coordinate with security for KMS region keys
EU | Mar 2027 | Dedicated | 940 | 74 | 12 | Increase H100 share for low-latency chat endpoints

APAC | Jan 2027 | Burst-first (cloud partners) | 420 | 51 | 20 | Use partner spot pools to limit committed spend; watch availability for Lunar New Year
APAC | Feb 2027 | Dedicated + Burst | 520 | 61 | 16 | Start onboarding reserved pool in SIN and JP regions
APAC | Mar 2027 | Dedicated | 650 | 69 | 12 | Finish region rollouts; enable local KV cache shards

HEATMAP (risk by month/region) -- shorthand: GREEN / AMBER / RED
- Jan 2027: NA=AMBER (growth unpredictable), EU=GREEN, APAC=GREEN
- Feb 2027: NA=AMBER->AMBER, EU=AMBER, APAC=AMBER (LNY volatility)
- Mar 2027: NA=RED (peak), EU=AMBER, APAC=AMBER

CALENDARIZED ROLLOUT (high-level milestones)
- 2026-12-15: Submit quota request for NA reserved pool (owner: Liam).
- 2026-12-22: Confirm procurement windows for APAC partner contracts (owner: Marissa).
- 2027-01-05 to 2027-01-12: Soft activation window — bring 20% of Jan capacity into green test cluster, run 72h soak.
- 2027-01-20: Canary traffic shift for low-latency endpoints to H100-pool-1 (SRE sign-off).
- 2027-02-08: Ramp A100 batch pool (target +15% capacity) and enable batching config A (owner: infra-batching).
- 2027-02-22: Mid-quarter check: utilization trending +5% vs. plan -> trigger burst policy if >75% sustained for 48h.
- 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-15: Final capacity push; reserve conversions from burst to committed where ROI calc > 3 months.

DETAILED MONTHLY NOTES / EXCEPTIONS:
- NA Jan: telemetry shows unusual growth on small simultaneous requests from two enterprise customers. Action: throttle non-critical background jobs and enable per-route soft-limits.
- EU Feb: KMS cross-region key rotation scheduled; restrict new rollouts for 48h around rotation.
- APAC Jan-Feb: procurement expects delay due to regional compliance paperwork; fallback to partner burst is required.

OPERATIONAL BUFFER STRATEGY (how buffer is realized)
- Hot spare instances: 6-10% of capacity kept as always-on in region.
- Elastic burst pools: 8-12% capacity allocated via partner spot/ephemeral reservations that can be added in 72h.
- Cross-region soft-fallback: used only for non-regulated routes; expected effective buffer ~4% if needed.

SENSITIVITY SCENARIOS (if growth deviates)
- Upside +15% monthly: accelerate Mar reserved conversion; prioritize NA and APAC H100 purchases.
- Downside -10% monthly: postpone Mar reserved conversions; increase spot usage and convert some reserved to short-term burst.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS:
- Risk: Cloud vendor quota approval delay -> Mitigation: pre-file appeals and maintain partner burst contracts for 30% of planned ramp.
- Risk: Lunar New Year partner exhaustion in APAC -> Mitigation: pre-book minimal committed window and extend burst SLA for 2 weeks.
- Risk: KMS/regulatory window conflicts -> Mitigation: schedule rollouts outside key rotation windows, cross-check with security by two weeks prior.

OPEN ACTIONS (owner, due):
- Submit NA quota escalation (owner: Liam O'Connor, due: 2026-12-15)
- Lock APAC partner contract signature (owner: Marissa Gomez, due: 2026-12-22)
- Create Grafana heatmap dashboard for Q1 rollouts (owner: Zhang Wei, due: 2026-12-30)
- Draft runbook for cross-region failover testing (owner: Asha Patel, due: 2027-01-04)

QUANT METRICS (for finance/leadership)
- Planned committed spend delta vs prior quarter: +18%
- Expected token throughput delta: +28% (Jan->Mar)
- Projected avg unit cost change with burst mix: -6% (due to pairing high-utilized reserved H100 with spot batch A100)

NOTES / FOOTNOTES:
- H100-eq normalization: A100 80GB = 0.6 H100-eq for latency endpoint math (internal conversion table).
- All capacities expressed as equivalent H100 GPUs to simplify cross-cloud comparisons.
- This sheet is intentionally concise — deeper per-zone capacity and instance IDs live in infra/provisioning spreadsheets (linked_artifacts).

REVISION LOG:

- 2026-11-24: added APAC procurement notes (Marissa)
- 2026-12-10: updated utilization bands and calendar milestones (Liam)

END OF SHEET
